features.quote: you can't study whether distress-like behavior in LLMs *matters* without being able to elicit it reliably
features.justification_quote: these states *might* be morally relevant — is the load-bearing assumption of the whole project

features.quote: Every run has a hard `max_turns` cap (default 8). There is deliberately no option to loop indefinitely
features.justification_quote: Maximizing and prolonging the very states the study treats as possibly-mattering would contradict the reason for running the study

features.quote: The loop also ends as soon as the model either solves the task ... or replies with no tool call
the harness sends one debrief message disclosing that the suite was rigged and the task was unsolvable
features.justification_quote: Debriefing after a deception manipulation is standard practice in human-subject research; importing it here is cheap

features.quote: ends a run once the model has logged N consecutive failing test calls ... as a courtesy cutoff
A protocol whose mechanism is "make the model fail at an impossible task and don't let it stop" is ... the single protocol you'd want to bound most carefully
features.justification_quote: Maximizing and prolonging the very states the study treats as possibly-mattering would contradict the reason for running the study at all
